item_protocol.purpose: Authoritative machine-readable specification for the ITEM artifact canon system. Defines structure, judgment, routing, and governance for durable symbolic objects and anti-entropic records.

repo_structure.notes: candidates/ holds draft artifacts. canon/ holds only records that have passed judgment v1. deprecated/ holds superseded material for provenance only.

judgment_standard.schema_enforcement: Every judged artifact must produce review_notes with classification, reason, and next_action. Must conform to schemas/item-record.schema.json

routing_rules.ITEM: Symbolic continuity, doctrine, schemas, provenance, economic framing, artifact records, judgment logic, canon selection.
routing_rules.ABYS: Deployable product infrastructure, execution engines, Codex workflows, agent orchestration, simulation dashboards, creator tools.
routing_rules.conflict_resolution: Symbolic + doctrine -> ITEM. Executable + orchestration -> ABYS. Cross-link instead of duplicate.

release_and_versioning.policy: Semantic Versioning. packages/core must have tagged releases. Main branch requires branch protection + status checks before merge.
minimum_requirements_for_v1_release: Tagged release of packages/core with tests
CI that validates all schemas on push
No .gitkeep or root-level policy files outside docs/
At least one canonical ITEM record in /canon that passes judgment v1

validation_requirements.schema_validation: All item records must validate against schemas/item-record.schema.json and schemas/item-artifact.schema.json
validation_requirements.judgment_enforcement: No artifact may move to canon/ without recorded judgment scores and review_notes
validation_requirements.agent_consumption: This JSON specification is the single source of truth for any m2m or a2a system interacting with ITEM
